name: wowstudio-accessibility-kit
description: Helps you find, fix, document, and monitor WCAG accessibility issues in WordPress at the code level.
author: WOWStudio

scripts.makepot: bin/build.sh && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wowstudio-accessibility-kit wp i18n make-pot dist/wowstudio-accessibility-kit languages/wowstudio-accessibility-kit.pot --domain=wowstudio-accessibility-kit --exclude=vendor,freemius
scripts.plugin-check: bin/build.sh && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wowstudio-accessibility-kit wp plugin check dist/wowstudio-accessibility-kit --exclude-directories=freemius --format=table
